units.title: Language in Context
learningOutcomes: Analyze how language constructs meaning in various contexts
Apply grammatical conventions accurately in writing and speech
Produce coherent, well-structured texts for different purposes and audiences
Critically evaluate media messages and bias

assessment.project: Media literacy portfolio (analyze 3 advertisements with written commentary)

units.title: Literature Study
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate detailed knowledge of prescribed texts
Apply literary terminology accurately in analysis
Evaluate texts using multiple critical perspectives
Relate literature to contemporary South African issues

assessment.project: Comparative analysis podcast/video (2 texts + modern parallel)

units.title: Examination Preparation & Integration
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate metacognitive awareness of learning progress
